name: FND_SEARCH_OPTIONS_TL
description:
Stores Translatable attributes for Fusion Search Options.
These options are passed to Oracle Fusion Search (Global Search) at runtime.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display Name of the Search Options.  This value is shown to the user in the 'Global Search Configurations' Setup UI.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the Search Options.  This value is shown to the user in the 'Global Search Configurations' Setup UI.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_PLACEHOLDER
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_PLACEHOLDER - The placeholder or shadow text placed in the search field when it is empty.  This is used as a hint to the user.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_LABEL
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_LABEL - The label used against the search field.  If null, there will be no label.

columns.name: SUGGEST_NO_MATCH_MSG
columns.description: SUGGEST_NO_MATCH_MSG_ENA - Message to show if no suggestions are found.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Seed data file from which the row originates.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
